body: Read-only default-home check stopped before execution: hermes_cli/main.py calls _early_recovery.restore_interrupted_pull() before its --version fast path. The installed checkout currently contains .git/hermes-update-recovery, so --version could mutate checkout files. No default-home version command, repair/update, or native app launch was run. Default-home health is unverified; the TEMP-home wrapper health check had failed.
